sources.title: Blackfrost-AI/Qwen3.8-27B-ABLITERATED-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is the dense, deployment-friendly member of the Qwen3.8 family. This is the abliterated Blackfrost build: refusal behavior was reduced through a weight-level process, then the BF16 parent was converted into a standard GGUF ladder for local llama.cpp inference.

sources.title: I ran the tiny Bonsai model on my tiny GPU. Here's how it performed
sources.snippet: Bonsai 27B is a multi-billion parameter model small enough to fit into a smartphone. It's useful for dev and research work, but comes with trade-offs.
